🔈Volume Control_□×
Master
--%

Each source also has its own volume (the phone or app controls it too). Max volume (below) is the ceiling.

Output device

-

Mode: how the USB card is driven (its PipeWire profiles). Automatic is the card's best; try another if a quirky card stays silent. Pro Audio skips the channel and mixer logic.

Tone & volume cap
0 dB 0 dB 0 dB

Bass 100 Hz and treble 8 kHz shelves. Headroom adjusts itself so boosting never clips. Max volume is the loudest the speaker can get: the amplifier gain for the built-in jack, a software limit for a USB card (which runs at its full level). Each output keeps its own. Saved to the card 15 seconds after the last change.

🔧Settings_□×
Speaker name

Shown in Spotify, AirPlay and Bluetooth. Renaming restarts those services (about 30 s).

Spotify Connect

Checking the API key...

From the Spotify for Developers dashboard (Soloist). The key is write-only: this page can replace it but never shows it. Saved to the card; Spotify restarts.

Save & power

Checking for unsaved changes...

Factory reset forgets everything saved: Bluetooth phones, Wi-Fi networks (except any built into the card), the Spotify key, tone settings, radio favorites, the name. Also: hold S2 while powering on (LEDs blink fast; keep holding for 5 seconds).

💾System Update_□×

Installed versions
SlotVersionInstalledStatus
Checking...

The speaker keeps two versions (slots). Updates go into the one that isn't running; the other one stays as it is, so you can always go back.

Install an update
💾

Choose an update file (.pota) for this speaker, then press Install.

Update files are built for one kind of board and are signed: the speaker refuses anything else. Music keeps playing while it installs; the new version starts after a restart. If it doesn't come up healthy within 5 minutes, the speaker goes back to the previous version by itself.
